assertions.name: even-power ladder: H-bond rung is h² (the verified rung)
CH₄ per-contact vdW is the right order h⁴ (within 5×)
assertions.source: (L_vap/Z)/E_cov for CH₄ vs h⁴ — order-of-magnitude, not fit

description: The even-power h-ladder of interaction energies (h = q₀−q₀⁻¹): covalent h⁰=1, hydrogen bond h²≈0.044 (verified, H₂O/HF latent heat ~1–2%), van der Waals (the Hopf symmetric block) h⁴≈0.0019. Per-contact dispersion test on non-H-bonding liquids (CH₄, N₂; L_vap/Z over coordination Z≈12) lands at the right ORDER h⁴. The bare categorical symmetric block e₊ is ℏ_q-scale (≈0.10), far above h⁴; the suppression to the molecular per-contact vdW is the ARCHIMEDEAN 1/r⁶ inter-molecular separation (e₊ is the touching limit), NOT fixed by the Hecke decomposition. Tiered: the h-ladder is a structural near-match (order of magnitude); the exact vdW energy (coordination Z + 1/r⁶ archimedean separation) is OPEN, not fitted.

data.finding: Interaction energies form an even-power h-ladder (h = q₀−q₀⁻¹): covalent h⁰, hydrogen bond h² (verified), van der Waals h⁴. The vdW = Hopf symmetric block sits at the h⁴ rung; the per-contact dispersion of close-packed non-H-bonding liquids (CH₄, N₂) is the right ORDER h⁴. The bare categorical e₊ is ℏ_q-scale; the suppression to the molecular per-contact h⁴ is the archimedean 1/r⁶ inter-molecular separation (e₊ = touching limit), which the framework does not yet carry at molecular scale. Tier: h-ladder structural near-match (order of magnitude); exact vdW energy (coordination Z + 1/r⁶ archimedean separation) OPEN, not fitted.
